methods.text_en: Examine existing small-scale objects using real scale differences, without adding models.
methods.text_zh: 近看已有小尺度物件，利用真实尺度差，不新增模型。

methods.text_en: Compare before-and-after states only for an established repetition, without inventing a loop.
methods.text_zh: 只在原稿已有重复时对照前后状态，不发明循环。
